name: pig iron
lore_descriptor: rough cast and brittle, still pitted from the furnace
first_pickup_chronicle: Pig iron, slaggy. Takes no edge or blessing, but caves in helmets.
design_notes: Band A heavy metal. High mult (1.20), heavy (1.5 weight), enchant cap 1. Sister-archetype to tungsten — early-game brute material. Fills the F1-15 heavy gap.
